اقتطفا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفَا (iqtaṭafā) /iq.ta.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفَا (uqtuṭifā) /uq.tu.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اِقْتَطِفَا (iqtaṭifā) /iq.ta.tˤi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
